desc: BCM RECCE-11 MCMR features a steel Government profile barrel with a manganese phosphate finish with a barrel length of 11.50" with MOD 0 Compensator, aluminum receiver with a hard-coat anodized finish, M4 Feed Ramp Barrel Extension, M4 Feed Ramp Flat Top Receiver and fire controls marked SAFE and SEMI. Includes one magazine, cable lock, USGI Manual and FET. Made in the USA.
